# AI data centers are scaling fast. Let's build them the right way.

Water is at the heart of AI. You need water to produce chips, to power them, and to cool them. There
is no AI without water. And today, that matters more than ever.

[Read More][7][Watch Our Experts][8]

## We partner to make the world cleaner, safer and healthier - helping customers succeed while
## protecting people and the resources vital to life.

People Health

Helping people thrive by protecting their individual health, the food they eat and the spaces where
they live and work.

Planet Health

Helping the planet thrive by protecting the earth's climate and its most valuable resource: water.

Business Health

Helping businesses thrive by protecting their reputations and their bottom line.

[Get to Know Ecolab][9]

## We can help you measure – and reach – your goals.

eROI is the exponential return on investment that comes from improved performance, operational
efficiency and sustainable impact. By tracking Total Value Delivered of Ecolab solutions, our
customers see how they are achieving their sustainability and business goals together. Interact with
our eROI counter to see how much water, energy, waste and air is positively impacted by customers
using our technologies.
[Learn More About eROI][10]

## What’s inside matters…

For over 50 years, and in approximately 25 countries, our 6,000 associates have been using science
and ingenuity to create innovations that play a critical role in the everyday lives of many millions
of people.

[About Huntsman][87]

## Markets

### Aerospace and Defense

Improving assembly productivity, reducing weight and extending the lifetime of parts are imperative
to reduce costs in the aerospace and defense sector. As a leading global supplier of
high-performance materials, Huntsman’s products help customers improve production processes, realize
complex designs, reduce weight, and remain compliant with stringent standards and
lower long-term maintenance costs.  

[View Market][88] [View All Markets][89]

### Automation, Robotics and Engineering

Our polyurethane and thermoplastic polyurethane (TPU) elastomers and casting machines are used
across many industries to create components and technical parts for a range of applications. In
manufacturing, our materials improve the performance of parts in hydraulic, robotic and conveying
equipment, supporting the growth of smart factories and automation.  

[View Market][90] [View All Markets][91]

### Automotive and Transportation

Huntsman works with leading OEMs and their suppliers to develop effective solutions for the rapidly
changing demands in personal mobility. From the high-performance automobile to mass transit
transportation, Huntsman’s products and materials help the OEM to manufacture vehicles that are safe
and comfortable, with good aesthetics and reduced environmental impact through light-weighting and
improved fuel efficiency.

[View Market][92] [View All Markets][93]

### Building and Construction

Huntsman offers a range of innovative product solutions that improve the efficiency and
sustainability of building, construction and infrastructure projects across the world. Our
energy-saving thermal insulation, coatings and adhesives, composite wood products, thermoplastic
polyurethanes and foams help our customers develop applications for flooring, roofs, walls, facades,
doors, windows, driveways, roads and pipes.

[View Market][94] [View All Markets][95]

### Cold Chain

Huntsman’s MDI-based rigid polyurethane foam plays a critical role in reducing food waste and
extending the life of perishable goods. Our rigid foam provides outstanding thermal insulation
properties, leading to its widespread application throughout the supply chain of perishable goods.

[View Market][96] [View All Markets][97]

### Elastomers

Combining global reach with decades of experience in material innovation, we are experts in
polyurethane and thermoplastic polyurethane-based (TPU) elastomers and have in-depth knowledge of
their application across a vast range of industries. We have an extensive portfolio of hot and cold
cast elastomers, hot casting machines and TPU elastomers and develop solutions to meet specific
needs.

[View Market][98] [View All Markets][99]

### Electronics & Semiconductors

Huntsman’s innovative solutions are widely used in the electronics industry to protect devices
against chemical, mechanical and electrical loads. We offer a wide range of epoxy and polyurethane
encapsulant chemistries, and our broad industry experience and technical expertise allow us to
address the most stringent requirements for electronics applications.

[View Market][100] [View All Markets][101]

### Energy

The substantial improvement in global living standards in recent decades has created an
increasing demand for diverse, sustainable sources of energy. Used across major energy
sectors, Huntsman’s broad range of products help our customers meet this rising demand through
maximizing safety, production and efficiency, while reducing emissions and costs.

[View Market][102] [View All Markets][103]

### Footwear

Huntsman’s wide and varied range of polyurethane, thermoplastic polyurethane
(TPU) and textile-based solutions help footwear companies get to market faster.  To meet the high
demands and rapidly changing trends in the footwear market, we focus our innovation efforts on
sustainable solutions, automation, customization and smart manufacturing. 

[View Market][104] [View All Markets][105]

### Furniture and Bedding

Huntsman’s MDI and polyols are key ingredients in the production of flexible polyurethane foam, a
highly versatile cushioning material used in furniture, mattresses and pillows. Huntsman works in
close partnership with customers to ensure that consumer needs for comfort are constantly improved.
 Our sustainable textile solutions bring exceptional quality, safety, comfort and durability to home
and institutional textiles.

[View Market][106] [View All Markets][107]

### Industrial

Huntsman materials and solutions are used in several manufacturing industries to enhance the
effectiveness of the end-product. Our polyurethane and thermoplastic polyurethane (TPU) elastomers
are used to produce conveyor belts and monolithic belts, cast elastomers, extruded parts and molded
parts.

[View Market][108] [View All Markets][109]

### Sports and Leisure

Huntsman provides a range of market-leading solutions that are used to enhance the comfort,
performance and attractiveness of sports and leisure wear, as well as providing lightweight, strong
and durable materials for sports equipment and athletic shoes.

[View Market][110] [View All Markets][111]

## Product Spotlight

### Huntsman's Battery Materials Portfolio Enables Transition to Electric Vehicles

Huntsman’s battery materials are critical to the reliable operation and long working life of
lithium-ion batteries. These materials also help increase cell capacity by enabling higher
conductivity, thicker cathodes, and higher silicon loading in anodes. The Huntsman battery materials
portfolio can enable emerging technologies such as high silicon anodes, solid state electrolytes,
flexible batteries, and safer aqueous production methods.

We see chemistry as a means of solving some of the most pressing societal challenges of our time.

flexible batteries, and safer aqueous production methods.

[Product Information][112]
[Watch Video][113]

Find the right Huntsman product for you

[Product Finder][114]

## Careers

### Make a difference with us

The ingenuity and commitment of our employees drive innovations across a wide array of markets and
applications, enriching the lives of millions of people across the world. Our people-centered
company offers incredible opportunities for those prepared to take responsibility for their future.

[View Careers][115]

## Sustainability

### Our commitment to sustainability

We see chemistry as a means of solving some of the most pressing societal challenges of our time.
Guided by our support of the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals and coupled with care for
our neighbors, we create products and innovations to help meet the world’s growing demands for food,
water, energy and opportunity. Learn about our journey to become a more sustainable business.

[View Sustainability][116]

## Investor Relations

Huntsman Corporation is a publicly traded global manufacturer and marketer of diversified chemical
products with 2025 revenues of approximately $6 billion from our continuing operations. Our chemical
products number in the thousands and are sold worldwide to manufacturers serving a broad and diverse
range of consumer and industrial end markets. We operate more than 55 manufacturing, R&D and
operations facilities in approximately 25 countries and employ approximately 6,000 associates within
our continuing operations. For more information about Huntsman, please visit the company's website
at [www.huntsman.com][117].

## News

### Kemira strengthens its Water Solutions business in Europe by acquiring SIDRA Wasserchemie.

We at Kemira are in the business of chemistry expertise. Safe, sustainable chemistries are a part of
good life, ensuring hygiene, safe water, food safety and more.

We are the chosen partners for water-intensive industries worldwide, helping our customers design
for efficiency, reuse resources, and revitalize natural systems. With over 100 years of experience,
we partner with municipal water utilities, pulp, paper, board and tissue producers to deliver
visible improvements with our invisible enabler – the chemistry expertise of our 4,900 people.

Water treatment

Industrial solutions

to improve their process and resource efficiency.
[

### Water treatment

Municipal water and wastewater treatment plants are forced to comply with tightening regulatory r…

Municipal water and wastewater treatment plants are forced to comply with tightening regulatory
requirements, while tackling global megatrends, such as climate change, a growing population and
scarcity of resources combined with rising costs and supply-chain insecurities. Kemira offers a
range of innovative solutions to optimize all stages of the water treatment process, reduce expenses
for energy, labor and chemicals, while safely achieving the targeted water quality.

][118]
[
[Pile of bleached pulp.]

### Fiber production

Cellulosic fiber, a renewable and recyclable resource, is crucial for the circular economy. Our g…

Cellulosic fiber, a renewable and recyclable resource, is crucial for the circular economy. Our
global chemistry expertise helps industries to fully harness its potential. With our complete pulp
chemistry portfolio, strong fiber processing know-how, and digital services, we enable the
production of strong, clean, and bright pulp for packaging, tissue, and other traditional and novel
fiber applications. We help customers optimize pulp quality and environmental performance without
jeopardizing efficiency or profitability.

][119]
[
[Close-up picture of a box of tissues.]

### Fiber-based materials

As the world moves towards a more sustainable future, renewable and circular fiber-based alternat…

As the world moves towards a more sustainable future, renewable and circular fiber-based
alternatives are increasingly replacing fossil-based materials. With our unique chemistry expertise,
we enable traditional and innovative fiber-based end-products, ranging from paper, board, and molded
fiber packaging to tissue products, man-made cellulosic textile fibers, and nonwovens. We help our
customers achieve efficient, sustainable, and compliant production processes, resulting in
functional and safe products that meet even the strictest end-use demands.

][120]
[
[Factory workers walking up stairs.]

### Industrial solutions

From food production to the energy industry or metals and mining, we help water intensive industr…

From food production to the energy industry or metals and mining, we help water intensive industries
to improve their process and resource efficiency, contributing to the end-product quality. Water
treatment is an important part of all our customer industries, as raw water, process water, and
wastewater need to be appropriately managed, in the most cost-effective way. Sludge treatment offers
opportunities for further efficiencies and for creating value from waste.

### Water treatment

Municipal water and wastewater treatment plants are forced to comply with tightening regulatory r…

Municipal water and wastewater treatment plants are forced to comply with tightening regulatory
requirements, while tackling global megatrends, such as climate change, a growing population and
scarcity of resources combined with rising costs and supply-chain insecurities. Kemira offers a
range of innovative solutions to optimize all stages of the water treatment process, reduce expenses
for energy, labor and chemicals, while safely achieving the targeted water quality.

][118]
[
[Pile of bleached pulp.]

### Fiber production

Cellulosic fiber, a renewable and recyclable resource, is crucial for the circular economy. Our g…

Cellulosic fiber, a renewable and recyclable resource, is crucial for the circular economy. Our
global chemistry expertise helps industries to fully harness its potential. With our complete pulp
chemistry portfolio, strong fiber processing know-how, and digital services, we enable the
production of strong, clean, and bright pulp for packaging, tissue, and other traditional and novel
fiber applications. We help customers optimize pulp quality and environmental performance without
jeopardizing efficiency or profitability.

][119]
[
[Close-up picture of a box of tissues.]

### Fiber-based materials

As the world moves towards a more sustainable future, renewable and circular fiber-based alternat…

As the world moves towards a more sustainable future, renewable and circular fiber-based
alternatives are increasingly replacing fossil-based materials. With our unique chemistry expertise,
we enable traditional and innovative fiber-based end-products, ranging from paper, board, and molded
fiber packaging to tissue products, man-made cellulosic textile fibers, and nonwovens. We help our
customers achieve efficient, sustainable, and compliant production processes, resulting in
functional and safe products that meet even the strictest end-use demands.

][120]
[
[Factory workers walking up stairs.]

### Industrial solutions

From food production to the energy industry or metals and mining, we help water intensive industr…

From food production to the energy industry or metals and mining, we help water intensive industries
to improve their process and resource efficiency, contributing to the end-product quality. Water
treatment is an important part of all our customer industries, as raw water, process water, and
wastewater need to be appropriately managed, in the most cost-effective way. Sludge treatment offers
opportunities for further efficiencies and for creating value from waste.

enabling colorful smartphone cases, we find solutions to the challenges of today to help our

We’re committed to long-term investments and business partnerships, by harnessing innovation,

both to industry and to humanity. At SABIC we enable you to realize your ideas and make an impact.

We believe the answer to some of the world's biggest challenges lies in the natural human instinct

For over 45 years, our ambition to define the future of petrochemicals has yielded solutions for the

Creating sustainable impact

## For Generations

"For Generations" signifies our dedication to acting responsibly today to ensure a positive legacy
for those who come after us. Building on our process expertise and on our core beliefs, this program
is designed to foster trust and create value for Solvay, its stakeholders, and society as a whole. 
[Learn about the program][91]
[AIR Cover_1022x506px - 1]

## Annual Integrated Report

In 2025, Solvay delivered on its commitment to excellence in both financial and sustainability
performance despite a macroeconomic environment marked by geopolitical and  economic uncertainties. 

[Read our latest Annual Report][92]
[Solvay employees in France]

## Join our team and thrive

We actively seek employees whose personal values resonate with ours, as this alignment is integral
to fulfilling our mission. The journey begins with a steadfast commitment to our company’s core
values and purpose. We are essential chemistry, making progress possible for generations.

 

[Discover Life at Solvay][93]

## We are essential chemistry, making progress possible for generations.

Solvay, a pioneering chemical company with a legacy rooted in founder Ernest Solvay's pivotal
innovations in the soda ash process, is dedicated to delivering essential solutions globally through
its workforce of around 9,000 employees. Since 1863, Solvay harnesses the power of chemistry to
create innovative, sustainable solutions that answer the world’s most essential needs such as
purifying the air we breathe and the water we use, preserving our food supplies, protecting our
health and well-being, creating eco-friendly clothing, making the tires of our cars more sustainable
and cleaning and protecting our homes. Solvay’s unwavering commitment drives the transition to a
carbon-neutral future by 2050, underscoring its dedication to sustainability and a fair and just
transition. As a world-leading company with €4.7 billion in underlying net sales in 2024, Solvay is
listed on Euronext Brussels and Paris (SOLB).

Creating sustainable impact

## For Generations

"For Generations" signifies our dedication to acting responsibly today to ensure a positive legacy
for those who come after us. Building on our process expertise and on our core beliefs, this program
is designed to foster trust and create value for Solvay, its stakeholders, and society as a whole. 
[Learn about the program][91]
[AIR Cover_1022x506px - 1]

## Annual Integrated Report

In 2025, Solvay delivered on its commitment to excellence in both financial and sustainability
performance despite a macroeconomic environment marked by geopolitical and  economic uncertainties. 

[Read our latest Annual Report][92]
[Solvay employees in France]

## Join our team and thrive

We actively seek employees whose personal values resonate with ours, as this alignment is integral
to fulfilling our mission. The journey begins with a steadfast commitment to our company’s core
values and purpose. We are essential chemistry, making progress possible for generations.

 

[Discover Life at Solvay][93]

## We are essential chemistry, making progress possible for generations.

Solvay, a pioneering chemical company with a legacy rooted in founder Ernest Solvay's pivotal
innovations in the soda ash process, is dedicated to delivering essential solutions globally through
its workforce of around 9,000 employees. Since 1863, Solvay harnesses the power of chemistry to
create innovative, sustainable solutions that answer the world’s most essential needs such as
purifying the air we breathe and the water we use, preserving our food supplies, protecting our
health and well-being, creating eco-friendly clothing, making the tires of our cars more sustainable
and cleaning and protecting our homes. Solvay’s unwavering commitment drives the transition to a
carbon-neutral future by 2050, underscoring its dedication to sustainability and a fair and just
transition. As a world-leading company with €4.7 billion in underlying net sales in 2024, Solvay is
listed on Euronext Brussels and Paris (SOLB).

## Be part of what comes next in chemistry

Join a global community advancing chemistry, supporting scientific careers, and driving innovation
for 150 years, and counting.

Energy Security Framework Gas Prices Explained Permitting Reform American Energy Snapshot

### **AMERICAN ENERGY SECURITY FRAMEWORK**

Recent geopolitical disruptions and their impact on global energy markets have been a stark reminder
that energy security remains inseparable from economic security and geopolitical stability. The
United States is better positioned than most nations to navigate market volatility, thanks to
decades of investment and innovation that made America the world's leading producer of oil and
natural gas and a reliable supplier to global markets. But future disruptions will require a
stronger, more flexible energy system—one built on secure supply, modern infrastructure and
resilience.

The following recommendations provide a framework for getting there.

SECURE AMERICAN ENERGY SUPPLY
* Develop a Robust Federal Offshore Leasing Program
* Ensure Stable, Consistent Fuel Supply Through a Functional Renewable Fuel Standard
* Optimize the Strategic Petroleum Reserve

BUILD INFRASTRUCTURE AND MOVE ENERGY
* Pass Comprehensive Permitting Reform
* Improve the Jones Act to Unlock Domestic Energy Flexibility
* Provide Relief from Unnecessary Tariffs on Critical Energy Inputs

STRENGTHEN RESILIENCE AND SUPPLY CHAINS
* Work with Persian Gulf Allies to Reduce Reliance on the Strait of Hormuz
* Strengthen Western Hemisphere Energy Security

[Download The Framework][37]

### **AMERICAN ENERGY SECURITY FRAMEWORK**

Recent geopolitical disruptions and their impact on global energy markets have been a stark reminder
that energy security remains inseparable from economic security and geopolitical stability. The
United States is better positioned than most nations to navigate market volatility, thanks to
decades of investment and innovation that made America the world's leading producer of oil and
natural gas and a reliable supplier to global markets. But future disruptions will require a
stronger, more flexible energy system—one built on secure supply, modern infrastructure and
resilience.

The following recommendations provide a framework for getting there.

SECURE AMERICAN ENERGY SUPPLY
* Develop a Robust Federal Offshore Leasing Program
* Ensure Stable, Consistent Fuel Supply Through a Functional Renewable Fuel Standard
* Optimize the Strategic Petroleum Reserve

BUILD INFRASTRUCTURE AND MOVE ENERGY
* Pass Comprehensive Permitting Reform
* Improve the Jones Act to Unlock Domestic Energy Flexibility
* Provide Relief from Unnecessary Tariffs on Critical Energy Inputs

STRENGTHEN RESILIENCE AND SUPPLY CHAINS
* Work with Persian Gulf Allies to Reduce Reliance on the Strait of Hormuz
* Strengthen Western Hemisphere Energy Security

Global Pulp and Paper Provider

# Welcome to
# Apex Paper

[Our services][7]

### About Apex Paper

Headquartered in Vancouver, Canada, Apex Paper is a global pulp and paper sales and distribution
company built on strong relationships, market expertise, and a commitment to connecting producers
and customers worldwide.

We partner with leading paper and board mills worldwide to provide complete supply chain solutions,
logistics, and market expertise.

Your global pulp and paper partner.

[Learn More][8]

### Global Markets & Solutions

Apex Paper connects customers with first-line pulp and paper products from leading mills across
North & South America, Europe, and Asia. We also provide ‘Seconds and Trims’ solutions, handling
off-spec inventories, side-trims, start-up tonnage, and discontinued products to meet unique
customer needs. With professionalism and expertise, our team ensures the most efficient and reliable
supply chain solutions worldwide.

### North & South America

Honduras, El Salvador, Guatemala, Panama, Costa Rica, Colombia, Uruguay, Paraguay, Chile, Peru,
Brazil, Mexico

### Africa & Middle East

Ghana, Kenya, Uganda, Nigeria, Egypt, Lebanon, Turkey, Saudi Arabia, UAE, Kuwait, Oman, Jordan,
Greece

### Asia

Bangladesh, India, Pakistan, Sri Lanka, China, Hong Kong, South Korea, Malaysia, Philippines,
Singapore, Taiwan, Vietnam, Indonesia, Cambodia

## Products

Apex Paper offers a comprehensive portfolio of pulp and paper products, including Containerboard,
Kraft papers, Coated and Uncoated papers, Folding Carton, Newsprint, Specialty papers, and Market
Pulp, serving customers locally and internationally.

[Explore all products][9]


#### Containerboard

Kraft Linerboard (Virgin and Recycled) | White top Kraft Linerboard | Semi Chemical Medium |
TestLiner | Medium-Fluting



#### Kraft

Extensible Kraft Paper for Industrial applications | Standard Multiwall and Flat Kraft for Grocery
& Converting applications | Recycled Bag Kraft Paper | MG Kraft Papers



#### Packaging

Coated Solid Bleached Sulphate Board (SBS) | Poly Coated SBS Board | Coated Folding Box Board (GC-1,
GC-2) | Coated Duplex Board Grey Back (GD) | Clay Coated News Back and Kraft Back Board (CCNB –
CCKB)



#### Printing

Newsprint | Uncoated Freesheet | Coated Freesheet (Gloss, Matte, Silk) Text & Covers |Label Paper



#### Pulp

Bleached Northern & Southern Softwood Kraft Pulp (NSBK – SBSK) | Bleached Northern & Southern
Hardwood Kraft Pulp (NBHK – SBHK) | Bleached Eucalyptus Kraft Pulp | Bleached Chemi-Thermo
Mechanical Pulp (BCTMP) | Unbleached Kraft Pulp



#### Specialty

Colored Cover and Text | Manila File Folder | Kraft File Folder

## Trade Financing

[Get Trade Finance Support][10]

Apex Paper delivers innovative financial and risk management solutions to customers worldwide. In
partnership with Export Development Canada (EDC) and leading global financial institutions, we
provide reliable, world-class financial services.

Our services include:
* Short-term trade finance
* Documentary credit solutions
* Credit insurance facilities

For more information on credit insurance solutions from Canadian companies, visit [www.edc.ca][11]

### About Apex Paper

Headquartered in Vancouver, Canada, Apex Paper is a global pulp and paper sales and distribution
company built on strong relationships, market expertise, and a commitment to connecting producers
and customers worldwide.

We partner with leading paper and board mills worldwide to provide complete supply chain solutions,
logistics, and market expertise.

Your global pulp and paper partner.

[Learn More][8]

### Global Markets & Solutions

Apex Paper connects customers with first-line pulp and paper products from leading mills across
North & South America, Europe, and Asia. We also provide ‘Seconds and Trims’ solutions, handling
off-spec inventories, side-trims, start-up tonnage, and discontinued products to meet unique
customer needs. With professionalism and expertise, our team ensures the most efficient and reliable
supply chain solutions worldwide.

### North & South America

Honduras, El Salvador, Guatemala, Panama, Costa Rica, Colombia, Uruguay, Paraguay, Chile, Peru,
Brazil, Mexico

Greece

Bangladesh, India, Pakistan, Sri Lanka, China, Hong Kong, South Korea, Malaysia, Philippines,
Singapore, Taiwan, Vietnam, Indonesia, Cambodia

# 关于我们

扬子石化－巴斯夫有限责任公司是两个世界五百强企业中国石化和巴斯夫以50：50的股比强强合作的成果，是中德
企业合资合作的成功典范。公司位于南京江北新材料科技园，与园区内企业良好的协同效应，十分有利于公司的进
一步发展。

2001年9月，公司开始一体化石化基地的建设，一期总投资29亿美元，2005年6月全面投入商业运营。一期项目以年
产60万吨乙烯的蒸汽裂解装置为核心，共建有十套工艺装置。所有装置均贯彻巴斯夫的“一体化”理念并采用世界先
进的技术以节约原料和能源，降低排放和物流成本，充分发挥协同效应。公司还拥有一个天然气蒸汽联合循环发电
厂和数个国际码头，保证能源供应和物流运输。

2009年9月，公司启动二期项目建设，总投资约14亿美元，2012年1月投入商业运营。将蒸汽裂解装置扩建至年产74
万吨乙烯；同时扩建了原有的环氧乙烷装置，并新建了环氧乙烷精制单元；环氧乙烷衍生物价值链的新建装置包括
一套非离子表面活性剂装置，一套用于生产乙醇胺、乙烯胺和二甲基乙醇胺的醇胺联合装置以及一套丙烯酸二甲胺
基乙酯装置；碳4联合产品链新建装置包括一套丁二烯抽提装置，一套异丁烯装置...

# 人力资源

成为优秀人才更青睐的公司是扬巴公司的愿景之一。

公司为员工发展提供多样化的发展途径，致力营造促进员工发展的公司环境，并鼓励员工最大限度的利用可用的资
源。公司为每位员工提供了多元化的培训与学习机会，包括轮岗工作、主管和导师指导、同事分享以及培训课程，
以帮助员工更好地成长及发展。在扬子石化－巴斯夫有限责任公司工作，一切都与众不同。

2001年9月，公司开始一体化石化基地的建设，一期总投资29亿美元，2005年6月全面投入商业运营。一期项目以年

厂和数个国际码头，保证能源供应和物流运输。

# 产品与服务

我们为迅速增长的中国市场提供约300万吨高质量的化学品和聚合物，进一步加强对家庭护理与卫生行业、涂料、
纺织及建筑行业的支持，并以卓越的服务令客户满意。
* [
  
  # 蒸汽裂解产品和芳烃
  
  乙烯、丙烯、丁二烯、异丁烯、苯、甲苯、混合二甲苯
  
  ][57]
* [
  
  # 聚合物和环氧乙烷衍生物
  
  乙二醇、二乙二醇、三乙二醇、低密度聚乙烯、乙烯-乙酸乙烯酯共聚树脂、聚苯乙烯、非离子表面活性剂
  
  ][58]
* [
  
  # 丙烯酸类产品
  
  精丙烯酸、丙烯酸甲酯、丙烯酸正丁酯、丙烯酸二甲胺基乙酯、超吸水性聚合物、丙烯酸叔丁酯
  
  ][59]
* [
  
  # 醇类和中间体
  
  正丁醇、异丁醇、2-丙基庚醇、异丁醛、丙醛、正丁醛、混合戊醛、甲酸、丙酸、二甲基甲酰胺、二甲基乙醇胺
  、无水二甲胺、无水三甲胺、一乙醇胺、二乙醇胺、三乙醇胺、三乙醇胺混胺、乙二胺、二乙烯三胺、羟乙基乙
  二胺、68%哌嗪、高分子乙烯胺、高活性聚异丁烯、聚异丁烯V系列、90%新戊二醇溶液
  
  ][60]

# 关于我们

扬子石化－巴斯夫有限责任公司是两个世界五百强企业中国石化和巴斯夫以50：50的股比强强合作的成果，是中德
企业合资合作的成功典范。公司位于南京江北新材料科技园，与园区内企业良好的协同效应，十分有利于公司的进
一步发展。

2001年9月，公司开始一体化石化基地的建设，一期总投资29亿美元，2005年6月全面投入商业运营。一期项目以年
产60万吨乙烯的蒸汽裂解装置为核心，共建有十套工艺装置。所有装置均贯彻巴斯夫的“一体化”理念并采用世界先
进的技术以节约原料和能源，降低排放和物流成本，充分发挥协同效应。公司还拥有一个天然气蒸汽联合循环发电
厂和数个国际码头，保证能源供应和物流运输。

2009年9月，公司启动二期项目建设，总投资约14亿美元，2012年1月投入商业运营。将蒸汽裂解装置扩建至年产74
万吨乙烯；同时扩建了原有的环氧乙烷装置，并新建了环氧乙烷精制单元；环氧乙烷衍生物价值链的新建装置包括
一套非离子表面活性剂装置，一套用于生产乙醇胺、乙烯胺和二甲基乙醇胺的醇胺联合装置以及一套丙烯酸二甲胺
基乙酯装置；碳4联合产品链新建装置包括一套丁二烯抽提装置，一套异丁烯装置...

[查看更多][61]

# 人力资源

成为优秀人才更青睐的公司是扬巴公司的愿景之一。

公司为员工发展提供多样化的发展途径，致力营造促进员工发展的公司环境，并鼓励员工最大限度的利用可用的资
源。公司为每位员工提供了多元化的培训与学习机会，包括轮岗工作、主管和导师指导、同事分享以及培训课程，
以帮助员工更好地成长及发展。在扬子石化－巴斯夫有限责任公司工作，一切都与众不同。

# Repair, Protect and Improve

From power generation to oil and gas, water processing to petrochemical plants, Belzona Carolina
provides Belzona products and services to solve the maintenance issues that arise from equipment and
structures in many industries. As a Belzona Exclusive Authorized Distributor, we cover both North
Carolina and South Carolina, including the cities of Charlotte, Raleigh, Greensboro, Florence and
Greenville.

But most importantly, we offer peace of mind – local 24-hour technical support and on-site
assistance are just a few of the ways we provide solutions to your industrial maintenance needs.

# Repair, Protect and Improve

From power generation to oil and gas, water processing to petrochemical plants, Belzona Carolina
provides Belzona products and services to solve the maintenance issues that arise from equipment and
structures in many industries. As a Belzona Exclusive Authorized Distributor, we cover both North
Carolina and South Carolina, including the cities of Charlotte, Raleigh, Greensboro, Florence and
Greenville.

But most importantly, we offer peace of mind – local 24-hour technical support and on-site
assistance are just a few of the ways we provide solutions to your industrial maintenance needs.

## Everything you need to know about Business Stats

What is Business Stats and what do you provide?

Business Stats is a comprehensive business statistics portal offering verified market data, industry
reports, consumer insights, and forecasts across 170+ industries and 150+ countries. We provide over
one million curated data points, interactive infographics, and downloadable reports in XLS, PDF, and
PNG formats.

Our platform covers every major economic vertical — from Technology and E-Commerce to Healthcare,
Finance, Energy, Retail, Media, Travel, and more — giving professionals a single reliable source for
business decision-making.

Who are we? The team behind Business Stats

Business Stats is built by a team of 500+ professional researchers, data scientists, industry
analysts, and economists with deep domain expertise. Our contributors hold advanced degrees from top
universities and bring combined decades of experience from consulting firms, investment banks,
academic institutions, and global research organizations.

Every statistic published on our platform passes through multiple layers of verification — from
primary source validation to peer review by subject-matter experts — so you can cite our data with
complete confidence.

How do you become an industry expert at Business Stats?

Our experts are recruited through a rigorous selection process that evaluates academic credentials,
published research, industry experience, and analytical capability. Candidates typically hold
master's or doctoral degrees in economics, statistics, business, engineering, or a related field,
and must demonstrate subject-matter authority in one of our 170+ covered industries.

Once onboarded, each expert specializes in a specific market vertical (e.g., semiconductors,
pharmaceuticals, fintech, e-commerce) and is responsible for sourcing data, building forecast
models, authoring reports, and reviewing peer contributions. Ongoing training, access to proprietary
databases, and peer collaboration keep our team at the cutting edge of their field.

Where does your data come from?

We source data from more than 22,500 trusted providers including government agencies, international
organizations (OECD, World Bank, IMF, UN), trade associations, leading market research firms,
publicly traded companies' annual reports, academic institutions, and our own primary consumer
surveys.

Every source is vetted for credibility, methodology, and recency. We clearly cite the original
source on every chart and statistic so you can trace the data back to its origin.

Which industries and categories do you cover?

Our coverage spans every major economic sector: Technology & Telecommunications, E-Commerce, Finance
& Insurance, Economy & Politics, Health Pharma & Medtech, Consumer Goods & FMCG, Media, Internet,
Energy & Environment, Retail & Trade, Transportation & Logistics, Travel Tourism & Hospitality,
Sports & Recreation, Chemicals & Resources, Society, Real Estate, Advertising & Marketing, and more.

You can browse all major categories on the homepage or use the search bar to find specific topics,
companies, or markets.

Can I use Business Stats data in reports, presentations, and publications?

Yes. Paid account holders may download statistics as XLS, PDF, or PNG and embed them in internal
presentations, client deliverables, academic papers, and media articles — provided that Business
Stats is properly credited as the source alongside the original data provider.

For large-scale redistribution, white-label licensing, or API-based integration, please contact our
enterprise team for a custom license.

How often is the data updated?

Update frequency depends on the data type. Fast-moving indicators (stock prices, crude oil, exchange
rates) are refreshed daily or weekly. Market-size data, forecasts, and consumer insights are
reviewed monthly or quarterly. Annual reports and long-horizon forecasts are updated at least once
per year.

Each statistic on our platform shows its publication date and next scheduled update so you always
know how current the data is.

Do you offer custom research and consulting services?

Yes. Beyond our self-service platform, our research team can undertake bespoke projects including
custom market studies, competitive intelligence briefings, consumer surveys, forecasting models, and
strategic consulting engagements.

Contact our enterprise team to scope a custom engagement tailored to your business objectives,
timeline, and budget.

How do I choose the right subscription plan?

Our Starter plan suits individuals and students who need occasional access to basic statistics. The
Professional plan is ideal for consultants, analysts, and small teams who need the full database,
premium reports, and all export formats. The Enterprise plan serves larger organizations needing
multi-seat access, API integration, and a dedicated account manager.

Unsure which plan fits your needs? Compare accounts on our pricing page or contact sales for
guidance.

Is there a free trial available?

Yes. New Professional subscribers can start a free trial to explore the full platform before
committing. Many individual statistics, infographics, and topic overviews are also available to all
visitors free of charge — no account required.

Canadian Mining Expo 2025

We are excited to announce our participation in the **2025 Canadian Mining Expo**, taking place on
**June 4-5, 2025**, at the **McIntyre Complex in Timmins, Ontario**. This premier event, featuring
over **400 exhibits**, is a key platform for showcasing the latest innovations, products, and
services in the mining industry.

enhance efficiency and sustainability in mining operations. Connect with our team to discuss how we
can support your business in tackling the industry’s evolving challenges.

DRC Mining Week Expo & Conference 2025

**Join Castolin Eutectic at DRC Mining Week 2025 – Connecting Innovation and Opportunity**
From **June 11-13, 2025**, at the **Grand Karavia Hotel, Lubumbashi**, Castolin Eutectic is proud to
participate in **DRC Mining Week**, Africa's premier platform for fostering innovation,
collaboration, and sustainable progress in the mining sector.

Aligned with the event’s mission to unite people, organizations, and resources, we will showcase our
advanced solutions in **maintenance, repair, and wear protection**, designed to meet the evolving
challenges of Africa’s mining industry. Together, we can shape a brighter, more connected, and
sustainable future for mining and beyond.

**Changyu Pump** is a trusted **chemical pump manufacturer** established in 2006, specializing
in corrosion-resistant pump solutions for aggressive and complex fluids. Our main products
include magnetic drive pumps, centrifugal pumps, self-priming pumps, slurry pumps, and submersible

environmental applications.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Q: Are you a manufacturer or trading company?

A: We are a professional manufacturer in chemical pumps with high quality for more than 20 years.

Q: How to customize pumps and mechanical seals ?

A: Customers could send us application data, we will select suitable pump and seal types, or client
could send us drawings, We are well in OEM and ODM.

Q: How can I pay for my items? Which kind of payment can you provide?

A: Usually by T/T, 30% payment after PI confirmed, the 70% balance should be paid after inspection
before shipment. and L/C at sight.

Q: What information should I offer for quotation?

Medium: ******________******
PH: ________
Specific gravity: ________
Medium temperature: ________
Flow: ________m3/h
Head: _________m
Voltage: ____________V
Frequency: _________Hz
Power:_____________KW

Q: What is your minimum quantity?

A: One set is also welcomed to us.

Q: How long is warranty?

A: 1 year for main construction warranty.

Q: What is your lead time?

A: Normally 10 days. If client is in urgent, we have plenty of spare parts, we could finish
assembling and testing in 3-5 days.

Q: What about shipment or delivery?

A: Depends on customer’s requirements, We can do EXW, FOB, CIF,etc.

environmental applications.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Q: Are you a manufacturer or trading company?

A: We are a professional manufacturer in chemical pumps with high quality for more than 20 years.

Q: How to customize pumps and mechanical seals ?

A: Customers could send us application data, we will select suitable pump and seal types, or client
could send us drawings, We are well in OEM and ODM.

Q: How can I pay for my items? Which kind of payment can you provide?

A: Usually by T/T, 30% payment after PI confirmed, the 70% balance should be paid after inspection
before shipment. and L/C at sight.

Q: What information should I offer for quotation?

Medium: ******________******
PH: ________
Specific gravity: ________
Medium temperature: ________
Flow: ________m3/h
Head: _________m
Voltage: ____________V
Frequency: _________Hz
Power:_____________KW

Q: What is your minimum quantity?

A: One set is also welcomed to us.

Q: How long is warranty?

A: 1 year for main construction warranty.

Q: What is your lead time?

A: Normally 10 days. If client is in urgent, we have plenty of spare parts, we could finish
assembling and testing in 3-5 days.

Q: What about shipment or delivery?

A: Depends on customer’s requirements, We can do EXW, FOB, CIF,etc.

publications, decades of trade data, technical and white papers. We also offer services based on the

quantitative marketing research to understand clients properly. The key objectives are to examine
niche markets, outline the main drivers, and indicate the most hazardous obstacles. We track major
local and global trends in this field and strive to balance the quality level within a given time

Independent South America Market Intelligence

# Understand South American markets before you enter, source, invest or expand.

Econosur is an independent market intelligence source for Argentina, Brazil, Chile, Paraguay and
Uruguay — focused on country context, sector structures, trade corridors, resources, energy,
agriculture, logistics, digital markets and sustainability.

Use Econosur to evaluate a country, compare a sector or request a concise market brief before making
assumptions about South American markets.

[Start Here][98] [Reports & Briefs][99] [Explore Insights][100]
Country Intelligence
Argentina · Brazil · Chile · Paraguay · Uruguay
Sector Analysis
Automotive · Logistics · Forestry · Energy · SaaS · Blue Economy
Market Briefs
Concise country, sector and custom analysis on request
[Econosur — Market Insights on South America][Econosur — Market Insights on South America]
Editorial

Founded and editorially led by [Marcus A. Volz][101], economist and market analyst based in South
America since 2006. Econosur connects source-based research, regional observation and structural
market analysis.

Start Here

## Choose the right entry point

South American market questions become clearer when they start with the right structure. Begin with
a country, a sector or a specific market question that requires a short brief.

01

### [Evaluate a country][102]

Start with Argentina, Brazil, Chile, Paraguay or Uruguay. Each market follows different
institutional, logistical, industrial and commercial logics.

02

### [Evaluate a sector][103]

Compare automotive, logistics, forestry, agriculture, energy, lithium, digital infrastructure, SaaS
or blue-economy opportunities.

03

### [Request a brief][104]

Use a short market brief when you need a structured first view of a country, sector, competitor,
route, supply chain or market-entry question.

From the Region

## Market intelligence from inside South America

Econosur combines official data, sector sources and long-term regional observation from inside South
America. The platform focuses on the gap between how these markets are perceived abroad and how they
actually function on the ground.

The editorial perspective is shaped by long-term observation from Argentina and the broader Southern
Cone, with attention to trade corridors, industrial activity, resource systems, institutional
constraints, local company signals and the difference between macro narratives and operational
market reality.
* Regional observation from inside South America
* Market structure analysis beyond headline indicators
* Country-specific reading of Argentina, Brazil, Chile, Paraguay and Uruguay
* Connection between data, sector evidence and real operating conditions

Eurochem International Corporation was founded in California, U.S.A. in 1990. The creation of the
company was based on the first of offering European chemical technology, through our technological
agreements with basic chemical companies, which provides better performance and a nobler ecological
profile to the different markets that use chemical specialties.

# SINCE
# 1990

## One Source Supply

With more than 1,000 different products, EUROCHEM is the company with the most complete line of
cleaners, detergents, sanitizers and treatment products. This allows us to be a comprehensive
supplier of chemical products for any type of industry or trade.
* Lower cost
* Greater service
* Increased engagement
* Less administrative burden

## Bussines Units

Eurochem serves a wide range of industries and industrial processes with products and services for
cleaning, sanitizing and treating.

Servicing industrial and OPL laundries with detergents, bleaching compounds, sour, size and fabric
softners.

[ Learn more ][250]

Process aids for sugar, pulp & paper, oil & gas and water treatment chemicals for boilers, cooling
systems and waste water treatment plants.

[ Learn more ][251]

Providing pest elimination services mainly in food processing, food service facilities, retail
stores, etc.

[ Learn more ][252]

Servicing the food and beverage processing industries with cleaners, sanitizers and other
specialties.

[ Learn more ][253]

Provides with outsourced cleaning services mainly for the food processing industry.

[ Learn more ][254]

Delivering solutions for commercial and hotel housekeeping and industrial maintenance cleaning.

[ Learn more ][255]

Provides with detergents, sanitizers and other food safety chemicals for the foodservice industry.

[ Learn more ][256]

Marketing specialty degreasers and conversion chemicals for metal finishing.

Eurochem International Corporation was founded in California, U.S.A. in 1990. The creation of the
company was based on the first of offering European chemical technology, through our technological
agreements with basic chemical companies, which provides better performance and a nobler ecological
profile to the different markets that use chemical specialties.

# SINCE
# 1990

## One Source Supply

With more than 1,000 different products, EUROCHEM is the company with the most complete line of
cleaners, detergents, sanitizers and treatment products. This allows us to be a comprehensive
supplier of chemical products for any type of industry or trade.
* Lower cost
* Greater service
* Increased engagement
* Less administrative burden

## Bussines Units

Eurochem serves a wide range of industries and industrial processes with products and services for
cleaning, sanitizing and treating.

Servicing industrial and OPL laundries with detergents, bleaching compounds, sour, size and fabric
softners.

[ Learn more ][250]

Process aids for sugar, pulp & paper, oil & gas and water treatment chemicals for boilers, cooling
systems and waste water treatment plants.

[ Learn more ][251]

Providing pest elimination services mainly in food processing, food service facilities, retail
stores, etc.

[ Learn more ][252]

Servicing the food and beverage processing industries with cleaners, sanitizers and other
specialties.

[ Learn more ][253]

Provides with outsourced cleaning services mainly for the food processing industry.

[ Learn more ][254]

Delivering solutions for commercial and hotel housekeeping and industrial maintenance cleaning.

[ Learn more ][255]

Provides with detergents, sanitizers and other food safety chemicals for the foodservice industry.

Marketing specialty degreasers and conversion chemicals for metal finishing.

## FANUC and Google: Advancing Manufacturing Intelligence

FANUC is collaborating with Google to bring cloud-native artificial intelligence capabilities to
manufacturing plants, enabling smarter automation and predictive analytics across all production
environments.

[ Read the Announcement ][133]
[Image 800x600]
Collaborative Series

## CRX-10*i*A/L Paint

The CRX-10iA/L Paint cobot is the perfect industrial solution for manufacturers new to robotics.
This product line includes the CRX-10iA/L Paint cobot, which precisely dispenses materials for
uniform and reliable application in the paint, liquid and powder coatings, and fiberglass
industries. The CRX-10iA/L Paint cobot is the first and only cobot certified for painting in
accordance with U.S. safety standards and is the best option on the market for precision dispensing
applications.

[ CRX-10iA/L Paint ][134]
Collaboration

## FANUC Accelerates Physical AI in Industrial Robotics, Leveraging NVIDIA Technologies

FANUC is combining its global leadership in robotics with NVIDIA’s AI computing and simulation
platforms to deliver intelligent and adaptable automation. This collaboration integrates ROBOGUIDE
with NVIDIA Isaac Sim and Omniverse to create photorealistic digital twins, and enables robots to
interpret voice commands and automatically generate code.

[ Read the Announcement ][135]

### [ 25% Increased Output: How Thogus Transformed Helmet Production with Robotic Drilling ][137]

Thogus eliminated a production bottleneck, increased output by up to 25% and improved manufacturing
flexibility with a custom robotic drilling system powered by FANUC robots.

[M 10i D 12 Machine Tending]

### [ Achieving Zero-Defect Aerospace Manufacturing with Automated Grinding and Inspection ][138]

Pointe Precision machines mission‑critical aerospace parts with ultra‑tight tolerances. To ensure
flawless, scalable precision, they use automation where failure isn’t an option.

[M 710i C 45 M Sanding]

### [ Reducing Sanding Time by 50%: RC Industries Uses Automation to Improve Finish Quality ][139]

RC Industries improved finish consistency and reduced manual sanding strain by implementing an
automated solution with Complete Solution Robotics and Notre Dame’s iNDustry Lab.

[I2T SCARA Inspection Cell]

### [ Over 10 Times Higher Throughput Achieved Through Automated Inspection ][140]

BelleFlex boosted production 10x by automating disc spring inspection with FANUC robots — replacing
slow, inconsistent manual checks with fast, precise, and reliable quality control.

## CRX-10*i*A/L Paint

The CRX-10iA/L Paint cobot is the perfect industrial solution for manufacturers new to robotics.
This product line includes the CRX-10iA/L Paint cobot, which precisely dispenses materials for
uniform and reliable application in the paint, liquid and powder coatings, and fiberglass
industries. The CRX-10iA/L Paint cobot is the first and only cobot certified for painting in
accordance with U.S. safety standards and is the best option on the market for precision dispensing
applications.

[ CRX-10iA/L Paint ][134]

## FANUC Accelerates Physical AI in Industrial Robotics, Leveraging NVIDIA Technologies

FANUC is combining its global leadership in robotics with NVIDIA’s AI computing and simulation
platforms to deliver intelligent and adaptable automation. This collaboration integrates ROBOGUIDE
with NVIDIA Isaac Sim and Omniverse to create photorealistic digital twins, and enables robots to
interpret voice commands and automatically generate code.

## Creating

## packaging solutions

## for life's essentials.

Greif is a global leader in packaging products and services and is pursuing its vision: be the best
performing customer service company in the world. We produce steel, plastic and fibre drums,
intermediate bulk containers, reconditioned containers, flexible products, containerboard, uncoated
recycled paperboard, coated recycled paperboard, tubes and cores and a diverse mix of specialty
products. 

We also manufacture packaging accessories and provide filling, packaging and other services for a
wide range of industries, along with managing timber properties in the southeastern United States.
Greif is strategically positioned in more than 40 countries to serve customers of all sizes and
needs.

Greif 2030 Sustainability Targets

## 2030 SUSTAINABILITY TARGETS

These targets set specific and measurable goals that build on the company’s announcement in 2021 to
reduce absolute Scope 1 and 2 greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions 28% by the end of the decade.

The broader sustainability focus for the company continues to be advancing a circular economy,
reducing greenhouse gas emissions, and championing diversity, equity & inclusion initiatives.

[Learn More][126]
Target One: Waste

## 97%

**Reach Zero Waste to Landfill at 97% of its Production Facilities**

By reducing, recycling, composting, reusing, and incinerating with energy recovery, Greif targets
97% of its production facilities achieving zero-waste to landfills by 2030.

[Learn More][127]
Target Two: Circularity

## 100%

**Make 100% of its Products Recyclable** 

Working across a vast portfolio of raw materials and products, Greif recyclability targets will be
benchmarked by weight, and consolidated at a company level.

[Learn More][128]
Target Three: CIRCULARITY

## 60%

**Achieve an Average of 60% Recycled Raw Material Content Across Products**

Recycled content targets for Greif products are minimum averages benchmarked across a portfolio of
materials and products by weight, consolidated at a company level.

[Learn More][129]
Target Four: DIVERSITY, EQUITY, AND INCLUSION

## =

**Attain Global Gender Pay Parity**

Greif is on track to ensure colleagues receive equal pay for equal work by 2024 and is committed to
maintaining gender pay parity.

[Learn More][130]
Target Five: Suppliers

## 80%

**Evaluate the Sustainability Performance for 80% of Total Spend with Suppliers**

By aiming to increase the evaluation of the sustainability performance of its suppliers, Greif can
have a greater impact across its value chain.

[Learn More][131]

## GREIF LAUNCHES 2023 SUSTAINABILITY REPORT

Greif’s 2023 Sustainability Report covers our fiscal year from November 1, 2022, through October 31,
2023. This report is prepared in accordance with the GRI Standards and SASB Application Guidance and
fulfills the United Nations Global Compact’s (UNGC) annual Communication on Progress (COP).

Greif paper packaging is a net-positive recycler. Creating materials from scratch has a significant

### Green Tool

Calculate your carbon footprint with Greif. Both easy and cost-effective, the Greif Green Tool

## **Greif Barrier Technology**

We design and manufacture containers that do more than hold products, they actively protect what
matters most. Greif’s expertise in barrier science and technology helps keep your product exactly
where it belongs: inside the package, not absorbed into the container walls or released into the
surrounding environment.
* Reduces Emissions And Leakage Risks
* Maintains Product Purity During Storage And Transport
* Protects Against Oxygen, Moisture And Chemical Exposure
* Customizable Barrier Solutions For Your Specific Needs

Your drums don’t have to blend in, make them bold. Drum360 gives you the freedom to showcase

to everyday packaging needs, these drums are more than containers, they’re your next big marketing
moment.

* Endless creative possibilities for packaging and beyond

Greif is a global leader in packaging products and services and is pursuing its vision: be the best
performing customer service company in the world. We produce steel, plastic and fibre drums,
intermediate bulk containers, reconditioned containers, flexible products, containerboard, uncoated
recycled paperboard, coated recycled paperboard, tubes and cores and a diverse mix of specialty
products. 

We also manufacture packaging accessories and provide filling, packaging and other services for a
wide range of industries, along with managing timber properties in the southeastern United States.
Greif is strategically positioned in more than 40 countries to serve customers of all sizes and
needs.

Greif 2030 Sustainability Targets

## 2030 SUSTAINABILITY TARGETS

These targets set specific and measurable goals that build on the company’s announcement in 2021 to
reduce absolute Scope 1 and 2 greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions 28% by the end of the decade.

The broader sustainability focus for the company continues to be advancing a circular economy,
reducing greenhouse gas emissions, and championing diversity, equity & inclusion initiatives.

[Learn More][126]
Target One: Waste

## 97%

**Reach Zero Waste to Landfill at 97% of its Production Facilities**

By reducing, recycling, composting, reusing, and incinerating with energy recovery, Greif targets
97% of its production facilities achieving zero-waste to landfills by 2030.

[Learn More][127]
Target Two: Circularity

## 100%

**Make 100% of its Products Recyclable** 

Working across a vast portfolio of raw materials and products, Greif recyclability targets will be
benchmarked by weight, and consolidated at a company level.

[Learn More][128]
Target Three: CIRCULARITY

## 60%

**Achieve an Average of 60% Recycled Raw Material Content Across Products**

Recycled content targets for Greif products are minimum averages benchmarked across a portfolio of
materials and products by weight, consolidated at a company level.

[Learn More][129]
Target Four: DIVERSITY, EQUITY, AND INCLUSION

## =

**Attain Global Gender Pay Parity**

Greif is on track to ensure colleagues receive equal pay for equal work by 2024 and is committed to
maintaining gender pay parity.

[Learn More][130]
Target Five: Suppliers

## 80%

**Evaluate the Sustainability Performance for 80% of Total Spend with Suppliers**

By aiming to increase the evaluation of the sustainability performance of its suppliers, Greif can
have a greater impact across its value chain.

[Learn More][131]

# What we do

Hawkins Wright is an independent consultancy providing market intelligence and business information
services to the international pulp, paper and bioenergy industries. These services include private
consultancy assignments covering a full range of marketing and strategic subjects as well as regular
multi-client reports and newsletters.

Through our extensive travel and primary market research we have developed an unrivalled network of
contacts, enabling us to keep abreast of the latest market developments. With more than 35 years of
experience, we are a trusted source of market intelligence for the international pulp, paper and
bioenergy industries.

# Pulp & Paper

Hawkins Wright was established over thirty years ago to provide independent market research and
business consultancy for the global pulp and paper industry. Our services for this sector range from
market due diligence assignments on behalf of project developers and financial institutions, to
multi-client reports which typically provide market analysis on issues of supply and demand, costs,
and prices (including forecasts). Our expertise covers all grades of pulp and paper, across all
regions. We are also the industry’s primary reference point for understanding the complex China
market.
 
[Find out more][52]

[biomass plant]

# Biomass

Over the past thirteen years Hawkins Wright has established itself as a leading consultancy serving
the biomass and bioenergy industries. Our services include both regular multi-client publications
covering the wood chip, wood pellet and palm kernel shell sectors, and bespoke consultancy projects
for a wide range of public and private sector clients. Our expertise covers the entire biomass
supply chain, from forest investments and management, to fibre processing and transportation, and
use of biomass for heat, power and CHP generation. We are able to provide both sound economic
analysis and market forecasting services, as well as policy interpretation and risk assessment. 

[Find out more][53]
[keyoboard]

proposed investment project, or the development of a business strategy, or detailed research on a
particular aspect of a forest product market. We undertake such assignments on behalf of project
developers, financial institutions, government organisations, and existing producers.

## Heidelberg Materials North America

Lehigh Hanson is now Heidelberg Materials. In North America, Heidelberg Materials is a leading
supplier of cement, aggregates, ready mixed concrete, and asphalt with more than 450 locations and
approximately 9,000 employees.

## Material To Build Our Future

We're dedicated to our goal to create sustainable value with industry-leading products and solutions
to satisfy the construction needs of our customers around the world. See how we are Building a
Better Future for our people, our customers, our communities and our shareholders.

# Connecting the World.
# For Better Lives.

Manuchar is a leading distributor of chemicals across high-growth markets and actively trades
several other commodities like steel, polymers, and many more. Our scale, infrastructure and
expertise give you the competitive edge you need. Over 40 years of local presence and growth in over
180 locations in North & Latin America, Africa, Europe, the Middle East and Asia prove the value of
our end-to-end commercial, supply chain and financing solutions.

Scroll down

## Manuchar keeps your    production running. Anytime. Anywhere.

Manuchar is a leading distributor of chemicals in high-growth markets. We complement our Chemical
Distribution business with International Trade Services in steel, polymers and several other raw
materials. 

Manuchar is recognized as an exceptionally reliable partner throughout high-growth markets. Our
proven business model is based on deep local market knowledge and a resilient global distribution
and supply chain network, in line with our mission to keep your production running. Anytime.
Anywhere.

[Read more About us][28]

## Chemical Distribution
## One-stop-shop service offering across the value chain

Manuchar is a recognized leader in the local distribution, international trade and logistics of
chemicals in high-growth markets. We serve industries such as Home & Personal Care, Crop Nutrition,
Human Nutrition, Animal Nutrition, Mining & Energy, and other industries. Our Services in Chemical
Distribution cover the full value chain, from sourcing through our 10 sourcing offices up to
just-in-time delivery of goods to your factory.

the quality and accessibility of the foundational legal-entity data on which you depend.

# Panjiva Supply Chain Intelligence Data-driven insights for the global trade community

[Plans and Pricing][13] [Request a Demo][14] [Free Newsletter][15]

## The Panjiva Difference

Panjiva is an intelligence platform that’s bringing transparency to global trade through our robust
global coverage, powerful machine-learning technologies, and dynamic data visualizations. Whether
you’re looking to identify potential business partners, keep track of competitors, or find
investment signals, our platform arms you with unrivaled insights to make supply chain decisions
with conviction. [Learn more][16]

## Smart & Intuitive Analytics

Our platform takes the power of **machine learning** and **data visualization** to give you clear,
actionable insights on global trade.

[Watch Demo][17]

## Find and evaluate legitimate businesses, faster

### 9 million companies and over 2 billion shipment records, just a few seconds away

#### Search for Importers and Exports

Our technology gives you immediate insight into the companies involved at every node of
international supply chains. From manufacturers and buyers to shipping and logistics, Panjiva allows
customers to better understand trade around the globe.

#### Take the data with you

Building a lead list for your sales team? Easily export the results and share them with your team to
expand their reach.

[[Screenshot-supplier-search-for-shirts]][18]
[Supplier Search for shirts]

#### Search your way

Whether you are searching for a product by name or classification, we make it easy. We support
commodity name, HS / HTS code, *D-U-N-S® Number*, and location-based searches.

#### Receive periodic email alerts

Save your search and receive email alerts anytime a new company matches your search criteria, or
when an existing company has new shipment activity.

## A Clear View of Each Company’s Activities

### Information and insights from authoritative customs and business information databases melded
### together to give a 360 degree view of businesses worldwide.

[[An example Panjiva Profile]][19]
[An example Panjiva Profile]

#### Actionable Insights

Powerful reporting capabilities let you spot trends in the import and export activities businesses
across the globe.

#### Top Customers & Suppliers

Discover new opportunities by seeing who does business with your peers or competitors.

#### Contact Information

Access the emails or phone numbers of key decision makers on over 1 million companies.

## A Comprehensive View of Global Trade

### We provide our clients with transactional data covering 35% of global trade flows.
### Armed with this data, you can decide where and when to invest.

#### Competitive Insights

Understand your market share by seeing where your competitors source their goods, and which entities
are involved in the shipment of goods.

#### Risk Analysis

Use our [platform][20] to analyze trade lanes or identify which companies have the riskiest supply
chains.

#### Sales Leads

Whether you’re targeting buyers, suppliers, NVOCCs, or carriers, Panjiva makes it easy to identify
the best sales prospects, learn more about their business, and make contact.

#### Xpressfeed™ Access Available

Use [Xpressfeed™][21] to push leads directly into your CRM system or feed data about publicly-traded
companies into your quant models.

[[Screenshot-network-view-diagram]][22]

### From Supply Chain Research

[[2026-07-17-sce-involution-600x370]][23]

##### [Supply Chain Edge: Evolving involution, forecasting transport prices, sourcing Ukraine’s
##### electronics][24]

July 17, 2026

– Mainland China’s anti-involution campaign is set to remain a supply chain policy priority even as
producer prices return to inflation, with the focus shifting from broad capacity cuts to demand
repair, investment discipline and higher returns on capital. The US removal of de minimis...

[More research articles ][25]

## Robust global coverage. Powerful machine learning technologies. Dynamic data visualizations.
## Surge ahead of the competition with Panjiva Supply Chain Intelligence.

# Panjiva Supply Chain Intelligence Data-driven insights for the global trade community

[Plans and Pricing][13] [Request a Demo][14] [Free Newsletter][15]

## The Panjiva Difference

Panjiva is an intelligence platform that’s bringing transparency to global trade through our robust
global coverage, powerful machine-learning technologies, and dynamic data visualizations. Whether
you’re looking to identify potential business partners, keep track of competitors, or find
investment signals, our platform arms you with unrivaled insights to make supply chain decisions
with conviction. [Learn more][16]

## Smart & Intuitive Analytics

Our platform takes the power of **machine learning** and **data visualization** to give you clear,
actionable insights on global trade.

[Watch Demo][17]

## Find and evaluate legitimate businesses, faster

### 9 million companies and over 2 billion shipment records, just a few seconds away

#### Search for Importers and Exports

Our technology gives you immediate insight into the companies involved at every node of
international supply chains. From manufacturers and buyers to shipping and logistics, Panjiva allows
customers to better understand trade around the globe.

#### Take the data with you

Building a lead list for your sales team? Easily export the results and share them with your team to
expand their reach.

[[Screenshot-supplier-search-for-shirts]][18]
[Supplier Search for shirts]

#### Search your way

Whether you are searching for a product by name or classification, we make it easy. We support
commodity name, HS / HTS code, *D-U-N-S® Number*, and location-based searches.

#### Receive periodic email alerts

Save your search and receive email alerts anytime a new company matches your search criteria, or
when an existing company has new shipment activity.

## A Clear View of Each Company’s Activities

### Information and insights from authoritative customs and business information databases melded
### together to give a 360 degree view of businesses worldwide.

[[An example Panjiva Profile]][19]
[An example Panjiva Profile]

#### Actionable Insights

Powerful reporting capabilities let you spot trends in the import and export activities businesses
across the globe.

#### Top Customers & Suppliers

Discover new opportunities by seeing who does business with your peers or competitors.

#### Contact Information

Access the emails or phone numbers of key decision makers on over 1 million companies.

## A Comprehensive View of Global Trade

### We provide our clients with transactional data covering 35% of global trade flows.
### Armed with this data, you can decide where and when to invest.

#### Competitive Insights

Understand your market share by seeing where your competitors source their goods, and which entities
are involved in the shipment of goods.

#### Risk Analysis

Use our [platform][20] to analyze trade lanes or identify which companies have the riskiest supply
chains.

#### Sales Leads

Whether you’re targeting buyers, suppliers, NVOCCs, or carriers, Panjiva makes it easy to identify
the best sales prospects, learn more about their business, and make contact.

#### Xpressfeed™ Access Available

Use [Xpressfeed™][21] to push leads directly into your CRM system or feed data about publicly-traded
companies into your quant models.

[[Screenshot-network-view-diagram]][22]

### From Supply Chain Research

[[2026-07-17-sce-involution-600x370]][23]

##### [Supply Chain Edge: Evolving involution, forecasting transport prices, sourcing Ukraine’s
##### electronics][24]

July 17, 2026

– Mainland China’s anti-involution campaign is set to remain a supply chain policy priority even as
producer prices return to inflation, with the focus shifting from broad capacity cuts to demand
repair, investment discipline and higher returns on capital. The US removal of de minimis...

[More research articles ][25]

## Robust global coverage. Powerful machine learning technologies. Dynamic data visualizations.

[01_01]



### Presencia y cobertura única en toda América.

 

Forsac es hoy en día el proveedor continental número uno en cobertura en toda América, orientado a
brindar las mejores soluciones de envasado a la medida de sus diversos clientes a través de sus
8 plantas industriales estratégicamente localizadas en Argentina, Brasil, Chile, México y Perú,
complementadas con una red comercial que incluye una oficina comercial en USA y una plataforma
logística que le permite atender hoy en día a más de 25 países en la región.

### Abastecimiento seguro y continuo de materia prima

#### Proveedor Integrado 

El papel Sack Kraft, utilizado por Forsac en la producción de nuestros envases, es fabricado dentro
de nuestro mismo grupo de Empresas CMPC. Esto brinda absoluta estabilidad y continuidad en el
abastecimiento del papel, permitiendo además ajustar y potenciar la calidad de nuestra materia prima
según los requerimientos de nuestros clientes. La utilización de fibra 100% virgen de Pino Radiata
en la fabricación del papel Sack Kraft y avanzados procesos de papelería, permiten lograr envases
más livianos con excelentes índices de resistencia, manipulación y porosidad.

[Leer más][16]






[1102]



 

 

 

 

 

## Somos parte del grupo de Empresas CMPC, una de las mayores compañías del mundo en la industria
## forestal y del papel. Fundada en 1920, fue pionera en Chile en la producción y fabricación de
## celulosa y papel, contando hoy en día con casi 100 años de experiencia en el rubro que avalan sus
## operaciones en negocios forestales, celulosa, papeles, cartulinas, productos tissue, sacos
## multipliego de papel, cajas de cartón corrugado y productos de oficina; participando en más de 45
## países en los cinco continentes

#### SOSTENIBILIDAD

### Comprometidos con el desarrollo sostenible

#### PROVEEDOR SUSTENTABLE

El compromiso con el desarrollo sostenible es parte esencial de nuestro modelo de negocios. CMPC
obtiene sus papeles a partir de plantaciones forestales propias que cumplen los estándares PEFC y
FSC lo que asegura la observancia de los elementos y normas esenciales para una gestión forestal
ambientalmente apropiada, socialmente beneficiosa y económicamente viable. El papel Sack Kraft es
biodegradable. Es un sustrato que, en buenas condiciones de humedad, oxígeno y temperatura, puede
reintegrarse por completo en la naturaleza en un muy breve plazo. Además el papel Sack Kraft es
reciclable y, como tal, es respetuoso con el medio ambiente permitiendo un fácil proceso de
recuperación de los envases ya utilizados para transformarlos en nuevos productos de papel. Todas
estas propiedades únicas y beneficiosas para el cuidado medioambiental convierten a los sacos
multipliego de papel en la mejor respuesta como empaque sustentable. 

[Leer más][17]

[proveedor sustentable]

## EL **PAPEL SACK KRAFT** QUE UTILIZAMOS CUENTA CON LAS CERTIFICACIONES **PEFC Y FSC**, GARANTÍA DE
## SUSTENTABILIDAD DE NUESTROS ENVASES.

## EMPRESAS CMPC REALIZA SUS NEGOCIOS BAJO EL PRINCIPIO DEL DESARROLLO SOSTENIBLE PROCURANDO
## ARMONIZAR EL DESEMPEÑO DE SUS ACTIVIDADES PRODUCTIVAS CON EL LEGÍTIMO DERECHO DE LAS GENERACIONES
## FUTURAS DE VIVIR EN UN MEDIOAMBIENTE ADECUADO. 





[Sacos_final]


### Papel Sack Kraft

El papel Sack Kraft utilizado por Forsac en la producción de envases es fabricado por Empresas CMPC
empleando fibra 100% virgen obtenida de plantaciones forestales renovables de Pino Radiata. 

#### PROVEDOR INTEGRADO

El fabricar este papel dentro de nuestro mismo grupo de Empresas CMPC, brinda absoluta homogeneidad
en el producto, así como también continuidad en el abastecimiento de papel, permitiendo además
ajustar y potenciar la calidad de nuestra materia prima según los requerimientos de nuestros
clientes.

### Presencia y cobertura única en toda América.

### Abastecimiento seguro y continuo de materia prima

#### Proveedor Integrado 

El papel Sack Kraft, utilizado por Forsac en la producción de nuestros envases, es fabricado dentro
de nuestro mismo grupo de Empresas CMPC. Esto brinda absoluta estabilidad y continuidad en el
abastecimiento del papel, permitiendo además ajustar y potenciar la calidad de nuestra materia prima
según los requerimientos de nuestros clientes. La utilización de fibra 100% virgen de Pino Radiata
en la fabricación del papel Sack Kraft y avanzados procesos de papelería, permiten lograr envases
más livianos con excelentes índices de resistencia, manipulación y porosidad.

## Somos parte del grupo de Empresas CMPC, una de las mayores compañías del mundo en la industria

#### SOSTENIBILIDAD

### Comprometidos con el desarrollo sostenible

#### PROVEEDOR SUSTENTABLE

El compromiso con el desarrollo sostenible es parte esencial de nuestro modelo de negocios. CMPC
obtiene sus papeles a partir de plantaciones forestales propias que cumplen los estándares PEFC y
FSC lo que asegura la observancia de los elementos y normas esenciales para una gestión forestal
ambientalmente apropiada, socialmente beneficiosa y económicamente viable. El papel Sack Kraft es
biodegradable. Es un sustrato que, en buenas condiciones de humedad, oxígeno y temperatura, puede
reintegrarse por completo en la naturaleza en un muy breve plazo. Además el papel Sack Kraft es
reciclable y, como tal, es respetuoso con el medio ambiente permitiendo un fácil proceso de
recuperación de los envases ya utilizados para transformarlos en nuevos productos de papel. Todas

## SolvChem^{®} Divisions
* ### Custom Packaging
  
  SolvChem^{®} Custom Packaging offers co-packing solutions for a wide range of industries and
  applications, helping customers deliver customized solutions in chemical packaging and blending.
  
  [ Custom Packaging ][43]
* ### Consumer Products
  
  SolvChem® Consumer Products provides Crown® branded and private labeled paint related  chemicals,
  cleaners, and fuels for professional contractors and DIY consumers. 
  
  [ Consumer Products ][44]

  SolvChem^{®} Distribution is a leading chemical distributor serving Texas and the south central
  US, offering prime chemicals as well as custom blends in bulk and packaged quantities.
  
  [ US Distribution ][45]
* ### International Distribution
  
  SolvChem^{®} International is a leading chemical distributor exporting a broad spectrum of
  high-quality chemical products to global customers with a focus on Central and South America.
  
  [ International Distribution ][46]

## About Our Company

Founded by Gabriel Baizan in 1971, SolvChem®, Inc. has grown to become and independent distributor
of organic chemicals that emphasizes quality across the paint sundry and household markets. What
began as a focus on the Houston market has grown to serve customers throughout Texas, Louisiana, and
Arkansas markets domestically now spans across the globe with a focus on Central America.

With the expansion of SolvChem^{®} International, SolvChem^{®} Inc.’s network of customers now spans
from the Port of Houston to Central and South America, Europe, Africa, the Middle and the Far East.
Through our four specialized divisions (US Distribution, Consumer Products, Contract Packaging, and
International Distribution), we remain dedicated to exceeding customer expectations by meeting
unique needs for the chemical industry.

[More About Us][52]

# **We are** **Suzano**

[Homem sorridente usando capacete e óculos de proteção em floresta, tocando a casca de uma árvore.]

The largest pulp manufacturer in the world, one of the largest paper producers in Latin America and
the leader in the toilet paper segment in Brazil. We learn from trees that life is always renewing
itself and, from them, it is possible to create sustainable products and solutions for a better
future. We invite you to learn more about our company in the About Us page.

[
Go to About Us
][122]
[Homem sorridente usando capacete e óculos de proteção em floresta, tocando a casca de uma árvore.]

## A Bioeconomy company

We develop sustainable and innovative products made from renewable raw material. Our brands and
solutions are part of the lives of more than 2 billion people around the world and are sold in more
than 100 countries. The Products and Brands page will help you recognize solutions that are already
part of your life.

[
Go to Products and Brands
][123]

## Commitments to **Renewing Life**

To create a better future, we need to transform the way we produce and consume. We have made
long-term commitments, aligned with the United Nations (UN) Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs), in
three dimensions: social, nature, and climate. Learn more on the Commitments page.

[

## **Innovation** is in our DNA

[Mulher cientista em jaleco branco e touca de proteção segurando recipiente transparente em
laboratório branco.]

We are driven by the need to do things differently and better every day. Therefore, we innovate in
our processes and products, and welcome others to innovate with us. Learn more on the Innovation
page.

[
Go to Innovation

## Want to join our team?

A world of possibilities and opportunities is open to those who believe in our purpose of renewing
life inspired by trees. To learn more about our way of working and job openings, visit the Join our
Team page.

# **We are** **Suzano**

[Homem sorridente usando capacete e óculos de proteção em floresta, tocando a casca de uma árvore.]

The largest pulp manufacturer in the world, one of the largest paper producers in Latin America and
the leader in the toilet paper segment in Brazil. We learn from trees that life is always renewing
itself and, from them, it is possible to create sustainable products and solutions for a better
future. We invite you to learn more about our company in the About Us page.
